pokedexEntries.rb: Although long extinct, in rare cases, it can be genetically resurrected from fossils.

pokedexEntries.ye: An ancient POKéMON that was recovered from a fossil. It swims by cleverly twisting its 10 tentacles about.

pokedexEntries.go: Revived from an ancient fossil, this POKéMON uses air stored in its shell to sink and rise in water.

pokedexEntries.si: This POKéMON from ancient times is said to have navigated the sea by adeptly twisting its 10 tentacles.

pokedexEntries.cr: In prehistoric times, it swam on the sea floor, eating plankton. Its fossils are sometimes found.

pokedexEntries.rs: OMANYTE is one of the ancient and long-since-extinct POKéMON that have been regenerated from fossils by people. If attacked by an enemy, it withdraws itself inside its hard shell.

pokedexEntries.fr: A prehistoric POKéMON that lived in the primordial sea, it swims by twisting its 10 tentacles about.

pokedexEntries.lg: Although long extinct, in rare cases, it can be genetically regenerated from fossils.

pokedexEntries.em: One of the ancient and long-since-extinct POKéMON that have been regenerated from fossils by humans. If attacked, it withdraws into its hard shell.

pokedexEntries.dpp: A Pokémon that was resurrected from a fossil using modern science. It swam in ancient seas.

pokedexEntries.hg: Revived from an ancient fossil, this Pokémon uses air stored in its shell to sink and rise in water.

pokedexEntries.ss: This Pokémon from ancient times is said to have navigated the sea by adeptly twisting its 10 tentacles.

pokedexEntries.bw: A Pokémon that was resurrected from a fossil using modern science. It swam in ancient seas.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: A Pokémon that was resurrected from a fossil using modern science. It swam in ancient seas.

pokedexEntries.x: A prehistoric Pokémon that lived in the primordial sea, it swims by twisting its 10 tentacles about.

pokedexEntries.y: Revived from an ancient fossil, this Pokémon uses air stored in its shell to sink and rise in water.

pokedexEntries.oras: Omanyte is one of the ancient and long-since-extinct Pokémon that have been regenerated from fossils by people. If attacked by an enemy, it withdraws itself inside its hard shell.

pokedexEntries.us: Omanyte lived in the seas of antiquity. Its fossils have been found bearing bite marks from Archeops, so apparently Archeops preyed on it.

pokedexEntries.um: It was restored from an ancient fossil. Those Helix Fossils are excavated from areas that were once oceans long, long ago.

pokedexEntries.lgpe: An ancient Pokémon that was recovered from a fossil. It swam by cleverly twisting its 10 tentacles about.

pokedexEntries.sw: Because some Omanyte manage to escape after being restored or are released into the wild by people, this species is becoming a problem.

pokedexEntries.sh: This Pokémon is a member of an ancient, extinct species. Omanyte paddles through water with its 10 tentacles, looking like it’s just drifting along.

pokedexEntries.bdsp: It’s a Pokémon that was resurrected from a fossil using modern science. It swam in ancient seas.
